A model of '''hovertank''' was used by the [[Hattan]] people of [[At Achrann]] in their conflict with the [[Troik]].<ref name="Can't Say" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> a [[Skeleton Crew|group of children]] lost on At Achrann encountered the Troik child soldier [[Hayna]] and hid with her from a Hattan [[tank]] patrol.<ref name="Can't Say" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The hovertank model was originally designed by [[Doug Chiang]] to represent the [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I]] in the [[1999]] film {{Film|I}}. Chiang's design was approved by [[George Lucas]] but ultimately did not appear in the final film. Chiang later returned to his designs and incorporated them into the [[Can't Say I Remember No At Attin|fourth episode]] of the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''.<ref name="Welcome to the Worlds">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-production-design-interview|text=Welcome to the Worlds of ''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'': An Interview with Doug Chiang and Oliver Scholl}}</ref>
